name: saas-app
summary: A multi-tenant SaaS starting point: organizations, roles, usage, settings, and the pages a product needs.
description: Starts a subscription-style SaaS product: organizations with roles and permissions, usage metering, settings, and notifications, styled with the enterprise theme, with blocks for the landing page, pricing, sign-in, onboarding, dashboard, data tables, settings, and empty states. Billing stays a product decision and is not included.
use_when: the builder is starting a multi-tenant SaaS product
the product needs organizations, roles, usage, and the standard product pages from day one
